body: apps/desktop persistence: libsql (@libsql/client file: URL) + drizzle-orm/libsql, DB at app.getPath('userData')/library.db. Migrations are a hand-rolled forward-only runner keyed on SQLite PRAGMA user_version (src/main/db/migrations.ts) — deliberately NOT drizzle-kit codegen, to avoid coupling the build to a codegen step tests skip. StorageAdapter parity with chrome-ext idbStorage is achieved via a single kv(key,value JSON,updated_at) table behind IPC channels storage:get/set/delete; structured projects/files tables are the Phase 3 baseline. Verified: electron-vite build (libsql externalized via externalizeDepsPlugin) + Node smoke (migration→user_version=1, kv round-trip). Electron-builder native-ABI test still pending.
